### What the Evidence Shows

- **No proven hangover cure:** Clinical evidence does not show that milk thistle (or its active compound, silymarin) prevents or treats hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXMmQMTVSPqPtpkNJejqVKbNdMaeYgdXtWFklvfrpkFfVMJVeEgngPUIXadmF-ULxuUcPiM2FbRQpccshF5YljATFm-Hc_r3UKjFNusHKedtJ1GqRen91dRzXGxC-ypugIPjbOuFD4d4xaVf0jWxsI5w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1z6dajyASVoKOFqj8Z9QOBLtIX8_KYtJWwdZZBCWXqdu90urtETe9oagu_R5htlePUB8Dnc9_ByvnKe6cui8WeBu019l77u9LottuS5R0CyRkLzF4vE77i80vNIkee4ek7UbrTvQiWpvFilBgDaBDwPoBE8OYi5fkRNBqWRv98nnZ58NIN5SrlCQM0bdApCB9Q)
- **Limited liver evidence:** Studies have not consistently shown that milk thistle stops alcohol-related liver damage or treats alcoholic liver disease.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1zCFmKAQT5FNY9s2iQcggPv58vxWY7S5xSc7d-1yf1ZtTRG5kkads1LjWb8lUvYJZgyAODFu7H2kt5WKZ-ZaV2l1hve_BlItabTFJnf_7czZWgzjciKnEnyuK4ykNG7VbIzPIChv_ho2OUkztDN9neL1D3bnQ6o1hawfbwkl70zGWe1GnUioJ8GpE33C4cS6xldnQe8RkKuDob6v)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXvYpab7XQl44b_6cW9z1V_PUiLHvOkKfc4ygKS4hMJeI2VS3CUoksm3CEVRA6bBHX-P4V2FrZkY3-kcq6ZiW8KuxH_8wFh108Jnk6_hU7AgArQVGPWMCRoZ-Iz2UBSaI4BXZOt-j-OQ)
- **General timing:** If you take milk thistle for general wellness, it is typically taken daily—often right before or after a meal to help with absorption—rather than timed around drinking. As [Cancer Research UK](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1zCFmKAQT5FNY9s2iQcggPv58vxWY7S5xSc7d-1yf1ZtTRG5kkads1LjWb8lUvYJZgyAODFu7H2kt5WKZ-ZaV2l1hve_BlItabTFJnf_7czZWgzjciKnEnyuK4ykNG7VbIzPIChv_ho2OUkztDN9neL1D3bnQ6o1hawfbwkl70zGWe1GnUioJ8GpE33C4cS6xldnQe8RkKuDob6v) notes, there are no shortcuts to avoiding the immediate or long-term effects of alcohol beyond drinking less.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF15pVM-71OPBfNTXt5PAXt0Ta-lJoebEnhFv2RpYxsyy1SRAxeXoXU8cotGoLXbszKpD0U8YOTLLuGGKLcuXWodxdfPSQjGxZFP_IMwd_GdN0NISKhG7gQy1RFsBlAtrHaj57VL1QHu7HFIQZfX3PovjGp2AN6gfDv_J4rbFfW98KLzynrMSk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF115Nnc1Cu-jsWqWFMxze-JTJnaxTuWWafIHHkc9-OZeBCPX07D7NK_hpyVPFuVjS3OKEm7X0Pmus9TE79JuTL6R1najzR-avoVnXQopcLayzMoFQpNrlgtjzdajukEhSKiw5I0y0RaPy94Qgx4acdAslVblkFkNX4YnKtn_a65fPXYmU8-6Rwukl_RTHHSFuYOHO17s5CC4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXTCOLDZhalEgCvK6s5eJNvkIjgpTjbiQOOjkdE3x7CunxQbDO00sWUt3NSwNpOc0xGa8zLJEJ-YX-T9teAdrC3QGMOyc_HqmJX_9FyiZZ4GvZ6reeaYelMAl1DGm_vtCa)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1zCFmKAQT5FNY9s2iQcggPv58vxWY7S5xSc7d-1yf1ZtTRG5kkads1LjWb8lUvYJZgyAODFu7H2kt5WKZ-ZaV2l1hve_BlItabTFJnf_7czZWgzjciKnEnyuK4ykNG7VbIzPIChv_ho2OUkztDN9neL1D3bnQ6o1hawfbwkl70zGWe1GnUioJ8GpE33C4cS6xldnQe8RkKuDob6v)
- **Community experiences:** On a [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF18XHkqtqdtaWF8d-Ew1vrtEjxz6WAszX1K-bMGeNWfAqoFHR8Mqs4ZkLAeo2ml3nh_J4bkwmvaqwJOOiu8Bbz0JKEHjhSxPINlhDVWwq6_h6glprWBOXYa8F6hY73f58hxbkOzlIdIVnNPpUTxSapfbwMZfPLtKyaEK-uHNQiVyf) thread, opinions are mixed: some users claim taking it before and after drinking helps, while others doubt its effectiveness for hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF18XHkqtqdtaWF8d-Ew1vrtEjxz6WAszX1K-bMGeNWfAqoFHR8Mqs4ZkLAeo2ml3nh_J4bkwmvaqwJOOiu8Bbz0JKEHjhSxPINlhDVWwq6_h6glprWBOXYa8F6hY73f58hxbkOzlIdIVnNPpUTxSapfbwMZfPLtKyaEK-uHNQiVyf)

### Practical Precautions & Safer Alternatives

- **Watch for side effects and interactions:** Milk thistle can cause upset stomach, nausea, or diarrhea. It may also interact with medications or trigger allergies in people sensitive to plants like ragweed, daisies, or marigolds. Talk to a doctor or pharmacist before using it, especially if you take medications or are pregnant or breastfeeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX_fQYPenjxr_8kd3fD0HkdsZ90unnZEbpgiGZdm_03OTx_J5cmc3fQ_TEK1HxltvpCAT6pmfVed4oc5-kW0IWILKYh8Xpi-ks4tkJO2TFMYzi47wOxCkbur9b979-hCPf5op0HWOwRXse205SKl6kc1LaZwcQJrGt)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXMmQMTVSPqPtpkNJejqVKbNdMaeYgdXtWFklvfrpkFfVMJVeEgngPUIXadmF-ULxuUcPiM2FbRQpccshF5YljATFm-Hc_r3UKjFNusHKedtJ1GqRen91dRzXGxC-ypugIPjbOuFD4d4xaVf0jWxsI5w)
- **Stick to proven basics:** Drink water before bed and between alcoholic drinks, eat food before or while drinking, rest, and limit how much you drink.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1zCFmKAQT5FNY9s2iQcggPv58vxWY7S5xSc7d-1yf1ZtTRG5kkads1LjWb8lUvYJZgyAODFu7H2kt5WKZ-ZaV2l1hve_BlItabTFJnf_7czZWgzjciKnEnyuK4ykNG7VbIzPIChv_ho2OUkztDN9neL1D3bnQ6o1hawfbwkl70zGWe1GnUioJ8GpE33C4cS6xldnQe8RkKuDob6v)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1z6dajyASVoKOFqj8Z9QOBLtIX8_KYtJWwdZZBCWXqdu90urtETe9oagu_R5htlePUB8Dnc9_ByvnKe6cui8WeBu019l77u9LottuS5R0CyRkLzF4vE77i80vNIkee4ek7UbrTvQiWpvFilBgDaBDwPoBE8OYi5fkRNBqWRv98nnZ58NIN5SrlCQM0bdApCB9Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXc_4lDsW9m3bq7LilVTfG9nk8GjFajG0fVoeki4-Uc_c2ORx8bsCd-N0Yfe7Qp2ofAhCd4eNNhzO0E1wsFwbS5okqklRY9EHjc2gt93L3f8cmaSeBjBcDAMq6hmvp8W0fPzgDyODLgVWJzt3yb1xpVa7s)

items.title: What the Evidence Shows
items.text: No proven hangover cure: Clinical evidence does not show that milk thistle (or its active compound, silymarin) prevents or treats hangovers. Limited liver evidence: Studies have not consistently shown that milk thistle stops alcohol-related liver damage or treats alcoholic liver disease. General timing: If you take milk thistle for general wellness, it is typically taken daily—often right before or after a meal to help with absorption—rather than timed around drinking. As Cancer Research UK notes, there are no shortcuts to avoiding the immediate or long-term effects of alcohol beyond drinking less. Community experiences: On a Reddit thread, opinions are mixed: some users claim taking it before and after drinking helps, while others doubt its effectiveness for hangovers.
